packages.name: node-ipc
packages.reason: The package was modified to include a malicious payload targeting users with Russian or Belarusian IP addresses, overwriting files on disk with a heart emoji.

packages.name: peacenotwar
packages.reason: The package was used to drop benign protest messages on the target machine and was added as a dependency to the maliciously modified node-ipc package.

analysis: The text describes an incident where the npm package 'node-ipc' was intentionally modified by its creator to include a malicious payload as a form of protest against the Russia-Ukraine war. The package 'peacenotwar' was also involved, used to deliver protest messages. This incident is an example of 'protestware', where software is used to promote a political agenda, potentially causing harm to users.
